description: Continuous crisis erodes planning capacity and future-oriented decision-making.
Present advantage is maximized while future harm is deferred.
Maintenance prevention public health and infrastructure investment are repeatedly deferred.
Digital and AI systems create inherited opacity and difficult-to-reverse governance systems.
Youth participation reshapes long-term governance and accountability.
Climate repair becomes a central intergenerational responsibility.
Long-term institutions align budgets laws infrastructure climate policy and public investment.
Repair and long-horizon stewardship are built into law budgets and public authority.
